baseline.commit_subject: Implemented the FedDF server aggregation algorithm (#411).

authorization.original_scope: Read-only baseline/audit agent. No nested agents. Read AGENTS.md and use zsh -lc for shell commands. Inventory core components, tests, configs, examples, CI/setup, concrete bugs and coverage gaps. Do not modify tracked files, install dependencies, commit, push, or start training downloads.
authorization.evidence_write: User subsequently authorized evidence/2026-refresh/baseline-findings.json as the sole allowed file write.
authorization.probe_scope: Static checks, dependency import/metadata inspection, and small in-memory production-method probes with recording-only optimizer, filesystem, configuration, and HTTP doubles. No training workloads or real network/storage operations were performed by the auditor.

root_supplied_results.result: client and server startup regression confirmed

demonstrated_gaps: Unit/integration tests invoke private methods and asyncio.run helpers rather than true synchronous client/server entrypoints.
FedAvg and Hugging Face smoke tests construct server updates directly and bypass real clients/socket transport.
Several smoke tests replace processor_registry.get with (None, None), excluding real processor composition and serialization.
LeRobot smoke constructs a synthetic config with partition_size instead of loading shipped LeRobot TOMLs unchanged.
Split-learning smoke invokes trainer callbacks; it does not execute a complete prompt/features/gradient/weights exchange.
MPC smoke patches DefaultTrainingStrategy.train and checks sample registration; it does not execute a full federated lifecycle.
No test source directly references FedAsyncAggregationStrategy, FedBuffAggregationStrategy, FedNovaAggregationStrategy, or PortAggregationStrategy.
Checkpoint tests cover tiny local names and trainer save/load, not Hugging Face names containing slash, server resume, Port retrieval, or multi-client disconnect cleanup.

confirmed_import_path_leak.description: FedDF tests permanently prepend the example directory to sys.path during collection.

stub_pollution_audit.confirmed_config_leak: Optional Config class sections persist across singleton resets; reproduced by B09.
stub_pollution_audit.distinction: Dependency fakes establish local adapter contracts, not real backend or true-entrypoint correctness.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Python 3.14 startup fails on both core paths.
confirmed_bugs.description: Client startup and server startup call asyncio.get_event_loop() synchronously without establishing a loop. Server lines 372 and 407 repeat this. Root confirmed the fresh-process regression.

confirmation.method: Root fresh-process runtime reproduction plus auditor source tracing

confirmed_bugs.observed: RuntimeError: no current event loop in synchronous startup on Python 3.14.

regression.red: Actual synchronous client/server startup fails in a fresh Python 3.14 process without a precreated loop.
regression.green: Actual client and server entrypoints in fresh Python 3.13 and 3.14 processes, with synthetic components and bounded execution, both reach startup successfully without the test precreating an event loop.

confirmed_bugs.summary: S3 uploads and downloads use different keys.
confirmed_bugs.description: send_to_s3 prefixes the key, then put_to_s3 prefixes it again. A fake-transport probe observed head /weights, put //weights, get /weights, even without a configured prefix.

confirmation.method: Auditor in-memory production-method probe with fake client/HTTP, plus root source observation

related_confirmed_defects.description: Empty S3 listing indexes response['Contents'] and raises KeyError.
lists performs one list_objects_v2 request without continuation handling, so it misses later pages beyond 1,000 objects.
related_confirmed_defects.confirmation_method: Static source trace; multi-page runtime not exercised.
Static source trace; stalled network runtime not exercised.

regression.red: Head/upload/download keys differ; empty listings raise; subsequent pages are ignored; transport has no bounded timeout.
regression.green: Payload round-trips with empty/nonempty prefixes use identical head, put, and get keys. Empty listing returns [], listings collect all pages, and both HTTP operations use bounded timeouts.

confirmed_bugs.summary: All three shipped SmolVLA experiment configs omit a required sampler field.
confirmed_bugs.description: The shared LeRobot data config selects iid without partition_size; IID construction requires it. The integration test supplies its own partition_size, concealing the failure.

confirmation.method: Actual TomlConfigLoader reads without Config initialization, plus static lifecycle trace

regression.red: Unchanged shipped LeRobot configuration reaches IID construction without partition_size.
regression.green: Load each shipped TOML unchanged, substitute only download boundaries, and successfully run client configuration and data allocation.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Hugging Face names containing slash break checkpoint paths.
confirmed_bugs.description: Worker checkpoint naming, default model saving, and test artifact naming interpolate the raw model name into filenames without creating intermediate directories. Server resume also differs from save: save sanitizes slash, resume does not.
confirmed_bugs.concrete_trigger: trainer.model_name = 'facebook/opt-125m' or another namespaced Hugging Face model name.

regression.red: Namespaced model names cause nested artifact paths or a server save/resume filename mismatch.
regression.green: A tiny local model named facebook/opt-125m completes worker artifact exchange, default save/load, test artifact persistence, and server checkpoint/resume using consistent safe filenames.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Generic gradient accumulation drops partial groups.
confirmed_bugs.description: GradientAccumulationStepStrategy neither flushes leftovers nor sets optimizer_step_completed. The trainer consequently also invokes optimizer-completion hooks on microbatches that performed no update.

confirmation.method: Auditor production-class AST extraction and recording-only optimizer probe, plus source protocol trace

regression.red: Two batches / accumulation four yields zero optimizer steps; five batches yields one and leaves pending gradients. Completion hooks are not gated by actual updates.
regression.green: Expect one and two steps respectively, no pending gradients, callback counts matching actual optimizer updates, and clean state across consecutive training runs.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Client disconnect cleanup deletes other clients' checkpoints.
confirmed_bugs.description: Cleanup matches every client ID in the shared directory. A filesystem-spy probe confirmed client 1 removes client 2's checkpoint.

confirmation.method: Auditor production-method AST extraction with filesystem spy

regression.red: Disconnecting client 1 requests deletion of client 2's checkpoint.
regression.green: Populate checkpoints for two clients; disconnect one and preserve the other client's model and sidecar files while cleaning only the disconnecting client's artifacts.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Port still uses the incompatible checkpoint format.
confirmed_bugs.description: Port's aggregation hook requests .pth, while the trainer rejects every extension except .safetensors. Port retrieval still expects .pth and torch.load.

regression.red: The real Port weights_aggregated hook calls trainer.save_model('model_<round>.pth') and encounters the extension guard.
regression.green: Exercise the real aggregation hook and subsequent stale-update similarity calculation with a tiny model; both use the supported format and matching loader.

confirmed_bugs.description: Tree flattening maps both 'a.b' and nested a -> b to the same leaf. A round-trip changed the first value from 1 to 2. A root _tree_metadata key fails restoration.

probe_observation.error: KeyError: Missing tensor data for leaf '_tree_metadata'.

regression.red: Colliding nested/dotted keys silently overwrite data; the reserved root key cannot round-trip.
regression.green: Add collision and reserved-key round-trips that preserve each leaf, or reject unsupported keys explicitly before serialization.

confirmed_bugs.description: Config initialization assigns evaluation, parameters, results, and general only when present. An in-memory two-load probe retained the first config's evaluator and optimizer settings in the second.

confirmation.method: Auditor actual Config constructor with in-memory loader responses and mocked directory creation

regression.red: Load with an optional section, reset the singleton, and load without it; the previous section remains accessible.
regression.green: Load-with-section -> reset -> load-without-section removes all stale optional sections and associated derived settings.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Timm scheduling starts one epoch ahead.
confirmed_bugs.description: The scheduler hook uses one-based current_epoch as a completed-epoch count. With ten batches, the first batch receives update index 11, rather than 1.

confirmation.method: Auditor production hook AST extraction and source epoch-number trace

regression.red: First-epoch per-batch scheduler indices begin at batches_per_epoch + 1, and epoch step uses an additional +1.
regression.green: Record scheduler indices and learning rates across local/global rounds; the first batch uses index 1 and epoch boundaries align with completed epochs.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Dirichlet sample counts change on every query.
confirmed_bugs.description: num_samples redraws partition size. A seeded probe returned 119, 78, 72, 105, 121; loader membership and aggregation reports can disagree.

confirmation.method: Auditor production-method AST extraction with deterministic numpy seed

regression.red: Repeated num_samples calls on one sampler produce different counts.
regression.green: Cache the chosen partition size and assert repeated queries remain stable and reported sample count equals actual sampled count.

confirmed_bugs.description: The extension loop repeatedly adds an empty slice without progress.

confirmation.method: Static loop trace plus one-iteration non-progress demonstration; the infinite loop was not run

regression.red: An empty dataset with positive requested partition size never exits the extension loop.
regression.green: A bounded subprocess regression observes prompt rejection or an empty partition without hanging.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Hugging Face partial groups flush, but are undernormalized.
confirmed_bugs.description: Loss scaling always divides by the configured accumulation count. Two unit-gradient batches with accumulation four produced 0.5, versus the group mean 1.0, through both final-batch and finalize paths.

confirmation.method: Auditor production-class AST extraction with recording-only optimizer and unit-gradient model

regression.red: Partial accumulation windows use the full-window divisor and shrink the mean gradient.
regression.green: Both known-last-batch and finalize paths normalize partial groups by the effective group size; full groups preserve their existing scale.

confirmed_bugs.distinction: Hugging Face does flush leftovers. The unflushed-leftover bug is in the generic strategy B05, not the Hugging Face strategy.

confirmed_bugs.summary: Strict MkDocs fails on two broken Nanochat relative links.
confirmed_bugs.description: Both links point to examples/case-studies from a sibling documentation directory and omit the required ../.

confirmation.method: Root strict MkDocs result plus auditor source inspection

regression.red: Strict documentation build reports exactly these two broken relative links.
regression.green: The strict documentation build resolves both links and completes.

additional_probe_observations_not_promot.interpretation: The fallback duplicates an episode when clients outnumber episodes. This observation was not promoted to a final bug because intended fallback semantics were not established.
A suspected zero-tensor encode failure was not reproduced and was not reported as a bug. These observations do not establish every QSGD round-trip or shape.

final_audit_assessment.conclusion: The passing suite misses concrete runtime failures; prioritize B01-B07 and add their red/green regressions.
final_audit_assessment.broad_coverage_statement: Audited 226 core Python modules, 59 test/helper modules with 250 test definitions, 57 configs across 15 families, 346 example Python files and 117 example TOMLs across 19 families, plus CI/setup and documentation. All tracked Python/TOML syntax and TOML include targets passed.
final_audit_assessment.key_evidence: Root reports 248 passed / 3 skipped on Python 3.13.16 and 3.14.8. Coverage is 43% overall, with client startup 18%, server orchestration 26%, S3 18%, training-step strategies 30%, and MLX 19%.
final_audit_assessment.source_distinction: Confirmed findings retain their evidence method. Static proven dataflow/contract defects are distinct from runtime-probed findings and from untested risks. Root-supplied results are identified separately from auditor-run checks.
